Title: Offline Transactions Dropped Silently

IMPACT: Data loss when tracking transactions while on the move (e.g., in subways or basements). {noformat} * *Acceptance Criteria:* {noformat}- Detect offline state using 'navigator.onLine'. - Queue transaction payloads in local browser storage (IndexedDB or cached queue) if offline. - Automatically sync queued items to Supabase when a connection is restored. {noformat}

Title: Missing Optimistic UI Rollback Handler
Description / Finding: * {noformat}ACTUAL BEHAVIOR: To make the app feel fast, new entries are shown on screen immediately. If the backend write subsequently fails, the UI does not remove the item, leaving unsaved data on the screen. IMPACT: Data mismatch. Reloading the page makes the visual transaction disappear since it was never actually written. {noformat} * *Acceptance Criteria:* {noformat}- Cache the previous state before applying optimistic additions. - On API write rejection, trigger a catch block that reverts the visual state to the cached version and shows a retry notification. {noformat}

Title: Client-Side Calculations and DevTools Tampering
Description / Finding: * {noformat}ACTUAL BEHAVIOR: The application calculates account balances, metrics, and risk scores in the browser and then writes those values directly back to Supabase. This allows users to open browser DevTools, edit local variables, and save falsified numbers to the database. IMPACT: Severe security vulnerability; easy data manipulation. {noformat} * *Acceptance Criteria:* {noformat}- Stop allowing the client to write calculated metrics directly to the DB. - Calculate net balances and health scores dynamically via Postgres database views or Supabase Edge Functions / RPCs. {noformat}

Title: iOS Safari Session Inactivity Purge

IMPACT: Poor retention, frustrating logout user experience. {noformat} * *Acceptance Criteria:* {noformat}- Configure the Supabase Client to run with custom long-lived cookie storage or a secure storage provider that Safari's aggressive local storage cleanup policy does not affect. {noformat}

Title: Missing Transaction Idempotency Keys
Description / Finding: * {noformat}ACTUAL BEHAVIOR: If a network connection drops or experiences latency during a transaction write, client-side retry logic fires the insert payload again. IMPACT: Inaccurate financial balances, duplicate transaction entries. {noformat} * *Acceptance Criteria:* {noformat}- Add a unique 'idempotency_key' UUID column to the transactions table. - Generate a single UUID in the client view *when* the submit button is clicked. - Database rejects duplicate keys using a Postgres UNIQUE constraint, preventing secondary retry duplicates. {noformat}

Title: Silent JWT Expiry Data Loss

IMPACT: Direct data loss. Users lose complex transaction history without warning. {noformat} * *Acceptance Criteria:* {noformat}- Implement a client-side interceptor that validates token expiration before submitting database writes. - Trigger auto-refresh via 'supabase.auth.refreshSession()' if the token is expired or close to expiring (within a 30-second window). - If refresh fails, block the UI, prompt the user to re-authenticate, and cache the unsaved form state.{noformat}

Title: Missing Database Row-Level Security

Any authenticated user can read, update, or delete all other households' transaction, income, and financial records. IMPACT: Critical security/privacy risk. Total lack of data isolation. TECHNICAL DETAILS: Users can query other tenant tables because the backend does not enforce 'auth.uid()' filtering rules. {noformat} * *Acceptance Criteria:* {noformat}- Execute 'ALTER TABLE transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;' on all database tables. - Build and verify policies ensuring users can only READ/WRITE records where 'user_id = auth.uid()' or within their shared 'household_id'. - Attempting to query another user's household ID via API returns an empty dataset or access denied. {noformat}
